about: The book's structure. Each chapter is written in chapters/<slug>.md, in the house markdown described in CONVENTIONS.md, and tools/spx.py builds src/<slug>.html and curriculum.json from it. 'sources' names what a chapter was rewritten from: 'dl:<number>' is a chapter of the dealer-lab curriculum as it was imported (source/dealer-lab, mapped by source/dealer-lab/outline.json), 'spx:<n>' a whole chapter of the SPX/XSP Edge Book (source/spx-book), 'spx:<n>.<m>' one of its sections, and 'spx:<n>/<heading>' an unnumbered section by its heading. 'figures' are the figures the chapter places, each exactly once in the book, except higher-order-greeks, which 5D and 7B share.
